node.title: (A2): Laurent's theorem gives the n-UNIFORM char-0 count
node.statement: By Laurent's theorem (Lang's conjecture for tori, PROVED classical mathematics), the torsion points of W_h lie in finitely many torsion cosets contained in W_h. Contained torus cosets = the toral components = the fiber loci (X24/x83 geometrically). Hence char-0 non-fiber trades number <= C(h), UNIFORMLY IN n. Subsumes X24's classification and explains every empty sweep. NEEDS: the citation verification + an effective version (Evertse / Beukers-Smyth / Aliev-Smyth lineage) for explicit C(h) at h <= ~40. [CITATION NEEDED - stated from memory]

node.falsifier: char-0 non-fiber trades growing with n at fixed h (the sweeps say no)
